scraped.title: Circular Economy
scraped.subtitle: Promoting Algerian Companies in the Circular Economy
scraped.clientName: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH (Eschborn Deutschland)
scraped.description: The project “Promoting Algerian Companies in the Circular Economy” finances by the German BMZ and implemented by the GIZ aims to strengthen the capacities of public institutions and support the development of innovative circular economy business models for micro, small, and…
body: The project “Promoting Algerian Companies in the Circular Economy” finances by the German BMZ and implemented by the GIZ aims to strengthen the capacities of public institutions and support the development of innovative circular economy business models for micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs). It also focuses on developing training formats and testing new marketing channels for circular products to assess their market potential and economic viability.

As part of the initiative, ICON-INSTITUT facilitated the participation of Algerian entrepreneurs in a delegation visit to the international plastics trade fair in Düsseldorf. The delegation offered participants the opportunity to explore the latest industry innovations, connect with international experts, build strategic partnerships, and identify new business opportunities. The project supported up to 14 Algerian MSME representatives.
